content.text: Only the About page differs, as expected. I'll check that the diff is limited to the team cards.

The team cards on the About page now centre the round initials, the name and the role. I added two rules in `site/css/pages.css`, scoped to `.member`, so no other cards change.

The functional tests pass. The visual tests pass for every page except About, at both desktop and phone size. The About diff image shows changes only inside the four team cards.

I didn't update the approved About screenshots, since the old ones show the left-aligned layout. If the centred look is what you want, run `npx playwright test tests/visual.spec.ts --update-snapshots` to re-approve them.

STATUS: DONE
